offering_description.value: Sells cloud communications and collaboration software to businesses of all sizes, including phone systems, video meetings, and contact center tools with AI features. Delivered as subscriptions over the internet, with the company running the hosted platform.

primary_products.value: cloud phone system; video meetings; contact center software; AI conversation tools; team messaging

primary_services.value: implementation and onboarding services; professional services; phone number porting

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses of all sizes, including enterprises, mid-market firms and small businesses; B2G: government agencies and public sector organizations

end_markets.value: professional services; healthcare; financial services; retail; technology

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring per-user fees for phone, meetings and contact center plans; service fees: implementation, onboarding and professional services fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hosted cloud communications platform sold to businesses as subscriptions; service provider: runs and supports phone and contact center services for business customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: cloud phone, video meetings, contact center and AI tools sharing business customers and one platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to enterprise and mid-market accounts; online: self-serve online sign-up and purchase for small businesses; partners / resellers: channel partners, resellers and telecom carriers that sell the service

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telecom emergency calling and number rules from the FCC, plus data privacy rules such as GDPR
